mapper.sql: d.deptno AS dept_id,CONCAT('D',d.deptno) AS code,d.dname AS label,d.loc AS city,NULL AS budget_code

e.empno AS staff_id,CONCAT('',e.empno) AS badge,e.ename AS full_name,e.job AS position,e.mgr AS lead_id,e.hiredate AS start_date,e.sal AS wage,e.comm AS bonus,e.deptno AS team_ref,(1-e.deleted) AS active
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dept d WHERE d.deptno=#{id} AND d.deleted=0
SELECT FROM dept d WHERE d.deptno=#{id} AND d.deleted=0
SELECT , FROM dept d LEFT JOIN emp e ON e.deptno=d.deptno AND e.deleted=0 WHERE d.deptno=#{id} AND d.deleted=0 ORDER BY e.empno
SELECT FROM emp e WHERE e.deptno=#{id} AND e.deleted=0 ORDER BY e.empno
SELECT FROM emp e WHERE e.empno=#{id} AND e.deleted=0
SELECT , FROM emp e LEFT JOIN dept d ON d.deptno=e.deptno AND d.deleted=0 WHERE e.empno=#{id} AND e.deleted=0
SELECT FROM dept d WHERE d.deleted=0 AND d.dname LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')AND d.loc LIKE CONCAT('%',#{city},'%') ORDER BY d.deptno

SELECT d.deptno AS "deptId",d.dname AS "deptName",COUNT(e.empno) AS "staffCount",COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(e.sal,0)+COALESCE(e.comm,0)),0) AS "totalPay",(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_account a JOIN emp x ON x.empno=a.staff_id WHERE x.deptno=d.deptno AND x.deleted=0) AS "accountCount" FROM dept d LEFT JOIN emp e ON e.deptno=d.deptno AND e.deleted=0 WHERE d.deleted=0 GROUP BY d.deptno,d.dname ORDER BY d.deptno

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "staff_total",SUM(CASE WHEN deleted=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "on_job_total",SUM(COALESCE(sal,0)+COALESCE(comm,0)) AS "pay_total",AVG(COALESCE(sal,0)+COALESCE(comm,0)) AS "pay_avg",MIN(COALESCE(sal,0)+COALESCE(comm,0)) AS "pay_min",MAX(COALESCE(sal,0)+COALESCE(comm,0)) AS "pay_max" FROM emp WHERE deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE dept dname=#{deptName},loc=#{city},WHERE deptno=#{deptId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE emp SET deptno=#{team} WHERE empno=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE emp SET deleted=1 WHERE empno=#{id} AND deleted=0
